audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven chart rows were inverted against the packet AND against the page's own whys — the chart said Ornn wins levels 3 through 5 and Heimerdinger wins level 6, while whys[2] says 'he keeps the wall', whys[3] says 'he edges 4-5 while you wait for R', and whys[4] says your R locks him down.
audit.why: Packet chart is Skill / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Heimerdinger / Ornn / Skill / Ornn, and every content why matches it row for row. The mirror (heimerdinger__ornn) flipped the same six rows.
audit.corrected: All six rows flipped as one atomic group across both layers; ratings set to 5,3,3,4,7,5,7 from your side.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5].why claimed the first-item stage as your spike; the packet marks it contested, and whys[5] on the same page says 'You're even'.
audit.why: Your first tank item lets you walk the grid but does not delete turrets, so the stage is genuinely shared.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why rewritten as contested with the grenade's 11s as the all-in trigger; phases[1]/[2]/[3].why rewritten to the Heimerdinger-favoured stages they now are.

audit.whatIsWrong: The grenade was treated as a blanket stun and no ability was ever given a number; packet.defects also flags that no Heimerdinger ability is named properly.
audit.why: Riot's text: the grenade stuns 'anyone directly hit' and slows surrounding units — the edge of it does not stun. It is a flat 11s at every rank. Micro-Rockets are 11/10/9/8/7s. UPGRADE!!! (100s) is not a cast of its own; it empowers his next spell.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t and phases[3].why.

edits.before: W brittle turns every trade into bonus %HP damage. Only take the trade when Heimerdinger's CH-2 Grenade is down.
edits.after: His turret grid and Hextech Micro-Rockets (11s) wall you off the wave while you still have no real answer.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Heimerdinger must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online, but he repositions the turret grid faster than one combo point breaks it — soak XP outside rocket range.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around CH-2 Grenade's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His grenade is an 11s stun that peels your charge, and one combo point cannot crack a full grid — farm safe and wait for 6.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on CH-2 Grenade's cooldown.
edits.after: Contested: your first item tanks the grid, but his turrets still chunk — all-in only on the 11s grenade.

edits.before: - Heimerdinger CH-2 Grenade: matchup-defining — His self-peel stun. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade: flat 11s — a direct hit stuns, the edge only slows. - Hextech Micro-Rockets: 11s at rank 1, 7s maxed. - UPGRADE!!!: 100s, and it empowers his next spell, not a cast of its own.

edits.before: His self-peel stun. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Flat 11s. Only a direct hit stuns — the outer ring just slows.

edits.before: Track Heimerdinger's CH-2 Grenade (Stun): His self-peel stun. Dodge it. When it is down — W-E + R him.
edits.after: Only a direct grenade hit stuns (11s) — sidestep it, then Searing Charge into your own pillar.

notes: 551 games is the thinnest sample in this slice; the chart is nonetheless unambiguous because the packet and the page's own prose agree row for row. Not written because the kit text does not carry it: whether Volcanic Rupture's magma pillar blocks turret beam or rocket lines (Riot's turret text mentions a 'pass-through beam' but says nothing about terrain), and whether Searing Charge can collide with a deployed turret as terrain — that would be a real dive tool if true.
